answers.core: This is a useful modification of the `rpc()` function and not an isolated feature that would be suitable for an asset library add-on.
answers.workaround:
This enhancement can be worked around with a few modifications, however it necessitates the `remotesync` function be converted to a `remote` function and be called manually alongside the `rpc()` every time the `rpc()` is called.
```
extends Node

var testvar = "Unset"
func _ready():
	var peer = NetworkedMultiplayerENet.new()
	peer.create_server(33333, 10)
	get_tree().set_network_peer(peer)
	print("Pre-Call: ", self.testvar)
	self.rpc("remote_function")
	var returnval = remote_function()
	print("Post-Call: ", self.testvar)
	print("Return Val: ", returnval)

remote func remote_function():
	self.testvar = "Set"
	return "Returned Value"

# Prints
# ======
# Pre-Call: Unset
# Post-Call: Set
# Return Val: Returned Value
```
